requirement: Exactly one API Hub host registration and instance must exist.
The API Hub API must be enabled and retained during destroy.
The host registration must use a full Google Cloud project resource name.
The host registration and API Hub instance must use the same explicit project.
The host registration and API Hub instance must use the same explicit location.
The deployment must create exactly one API Hub service identity.
The API Hub service identity must receive the admin and runtime project service-agent roles.
Encryption must use explicit Google-managed encryption or a valid CMEK CryptoKey resource.
Enabled semantic search must specify a Vertex AI location.
The API Hub instance ID must use a stable lowercase resource-safe format.
